name: Charge Tanks
author: Lars von Kolzenberg
description: Battery cell design from first principles, with anode and cathode as two tanks and lithium as the water between them.
tagline: A battery is lithium, two tanks and bookkeeping.
ogImageAlt: A battery is lithium, two tanks and bookkeeping: anode and cathode of a graphite/NMC cell drawn as two tanks.
